name: rich-input
description: Warp-style Rich Input Editor for Claude Code: a multi-line editor pane with @file/@folder autocomplete that hands the text back to the prompt

shortcutAction.title: Keybinding action that opens the editor
shortcutAction.description: Engine action (keybindings.json) whose shortcut opens Rich Input. Bind a key to it in ~/.claude/keybindings.json.

showBand.title: Show the button above the prompt
showBand.description: Draws the '✎ Rich input' row above the prompt (required for the keyboard shortcut to work).
